title: bee-core guard-support readers + command-registry JSON bridge + tokenize port
action: Guard-support pieces in bee-core (all read-only, zero subprocess inside the readers per D5): (1) READERS — config.json (hooks toggles, gate_bypass level, the FULL models map incl. advisor slots and CONFIGURABLE_SLOTS semantics from state.mjs), projected state.json (phase, feature, mode, approved_gates), reservations.json plus sharded lease records listing, cells listing (id/status/worker/files), PLUS the checkWrite support set the panel named (guards.mjs imports): worktree-holds (findForeignHolds, holdsStoreCorrupt semantics), workspace-store records, claims (readSession, heartbeatStale). Every struct round-trips unknown fields (D3, serde flatten pattern from rust-port-5). (2) REGISTRY BRIDGE — new file-based script scripts/dump_command_registry.mjs (spike-proven, 116 entries, 129KB) importing COMMAND_REGISTRY and writing .bee/cache/command-registry.json with a source_sha256 of command-registry.mjs embedded; bee-core loads that JSON, exposes name-to-schema lookup, and a staleness check (embedded sha vs live file sha) returns a typed Stale result — rust NEVER silently validates against a stale registry. Delivery note (decision 2026-07-26): at final flip this JSON becomes a release/onboard-generated managed artifact — the loader shape here is final, only the producer moves. Add a .bee/cache/ line to .gitignore OUTSIDE the BEE managed fence. (3) TOKENIZE — port the word-splitter exactly (quotes, escapes, chain separators: semicolon, single and double pipe, single and double ampersand), oracle-diffed against BOTH mjs copies (hooks/tokenize-command.mjs AND guards.mjs tokenize — the source of truth; they are hand-synced duplicates and drift between them must surface): file-based node drivers run both on the same corpus (heredoc markers, redirects, env prefixes, subshells) and the rust tokens must match both. ALL tests live in ONE integration target named guard_support (verify uses cargo --test guard_support — missing target exits 101).

truths: cargo --test guard_support runs (missing target would exit 101) and reports at least 12 passed
tokenize parity: rust tokens identical to BOTH tokenize-command.mjs and guards.mjs tokenize over the full corpus
registry lookup serves all 116 entries and flags staleness when command-registry.mjs sha differs
readers round-trip unknown fields on every store struct incl. holds, workspace, claims

artifacts.substantive: readers (config incl. advisor slots, state, reservations, leases, cells, holds, workspace, claims) plus registry loader plus tokenizer, guard_support test target
file-based dump script embedding source sha256; output to .bee/cache/command-registry.json

key_links: oracle tests execute the real tokenize-command.mjs AND guards.mjs via file-based node drivers
prohibitions: No edits to .bee/bin/ or packages/bee/ (D1 freeze — dump script is a NEW file under scripts/)
No subprocess spawns inside the readers themselves
The dump script writes .bee/cache/ ONLY; generated JSON never committed
No edits to crates/Cargo.toml members list

verify: node scripts/dump_command_registry.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p bee-core --test guard_support
